outcome_inspection_status: field frequencies inspected; no representation-model outcomes computed

grouping.inner_selection: grouped cross_validation within the nine outer-training piece groups

prohibited_current_event_inputs: any feature derived from the current acoustic trajectory
performance-workbook copied score-template row unless alignment is independently validated
targets.rationale: All 2303 declared performed notes map to author-documented broad motion classes; current acoustic fields are withheld because the annotation may have been informed by the same trajectory.

prohibited_current_event_inputs: number of simultaneous values in current R finger
current string, position, degree, range, or left-hand technique fields whose compound value cardinality encodes the same-event single-versus-multiple distinction
any current-event field mechanically constructed from the single-versus-multiple attack distinction
targets.rationale: The binary distinction is explicitly documented and recurs across piece groups; current right-finger multiplicity is withheld to avoid definitional leakage.

allowed: current non-target controls listed for the target
previous events only for sequential representation features
forbidden: current target or deterministic recoding of it
duplicate score templates as independent observations
piece identity used to memorize a held-out piece

representation_inputs.R0_atomic: R5 plus the previous event as one unsplit raw tuple; unseen tuples map to UNK.
representation_inputs.R1_pitch_centred: R5 plus separately encoded lag-1 and lag-2 pitch/degree/range states and auditable interval/change features.
representation_inputs.R2_gesture_centred: R5 plus separately encoded lag-1 and lag-2 documented gesture supercategories; T2 excludes current right-finger multiplicity.
representation_inputs.R3_flat_combined: R5 plus a single flat joint encoding of the same lagged pitch and gesture primitives available to R4.
representation_inputs.R4_multi_tier: R5 plus separate pitch and gesture histories and predeclared lag-aligned cross-tier association terms; no extra primitive information beyond R3.
representation_inputs.R5_context_physical: Only the target-specific shared controls; no candidate pitch-history or gesture-history representation.

estimation.model_family: regularized multinomial logistic model with categorical one-hot encodings and predeclared interactions
estimation.class_weighting: none for fitting the primary proper-scoring model; class-balanced metrics are reported separately
estimation.fallback: If separation or fold-level class absence prevents stable fitting, use a Dirichlet-smoothed categorical conditional model and mark the affected comparison exploratory.

metrics.uncertainty: Report the distribution across the 10 held-out pieces and a piece-level bootstrap interval; no token-level independence p-values.

complexity.selection_rule: Report a fit-complexity Pareto frontier; do not choose a post-hoc scalar lambda.
complexity.comparison_rule: R3 and R4 must use identical primitive information; any R4 advantage obtained from extra inputs is invalid.

missingness.target: Rows with undocumented, missing, cross-supercategory, or unresolvable target codes are excluded from target loss and counted by piece.
missingness.predictor: Do not impute from another dataset. Encode source-missing, unresolved, not-applicable and unseen-in-training separately where available.
missingness.previous_unknown_target: Represent as PREV_UNRESOLVED; never map source code 0 to no-technique without evidence.
